description:
The return-group cut needs a complete call-edge authority, not the broader fz-kdt.98.2 Reaches experiment. static_edges emits StaticEdge::Lambda for LoweredStep::Lambda but omits LoweredStep::FunctionRef, though both mint a callable value naming a function. Fold the two into one construction edge. Witness: ping/1 applying &pong/1 and pong/1 applying &ping/1 are singleton components today; after, they share one component and Recursive is true for both. A function reference closes over nothing, so it must not consume callable identity.

This is the body-edge half of fz-kdt.98.3. Keep the existing StaticCallees → DeriveCallGraphComponent path for this cut; do not introduce Reaches(f) or alter transport reachability here. TDD: both body edge sets are exact, both functions are recursive, corpus canon/artifacts remain identical, and json_roundtrip causal counts are recorded. Identical-source submission doing zero work is the separately blocked fz-tfn.57 source-replacement contract; this edge cut must not disguise that gap. Second commit of fz-kdt.98.

comments.text: Scope correction: a byte-identical submit_code replay of the witness currently applies 38 jobs (106 → 144) despite equal settled answers. That is the explicit fz-tfn.57 source-replacement bug, not a FunctionRef-edge consequence. The false ticket-local zero-work requirement was removed; this ticket records semantic exactness and json_roundtrip’s unchanged causal counts without concealing the broader gap.

title: A function reference is a construction edge of the call graph, as a lambda already is
